newsitem.title: GREECE: Crete car bomb hurts policeman's wife.
newsitem.headline: Crete car bomb hurts policeman's wife.

text.p: A bomb injured the wife of a senior Greek policeman on the island of Crete on Tuesday and police said it was probably a local criminal act.
The wife of the police chief of the main city of Iraklio, Costas Soldatos, was taken to hospital with serious injuries after her car, apparently rigged with explosive, exploded.
"The bomb exploded as soon as she turned on the engine," a policeman said.
Police said similar attacks on Crete in the past had been attributed to local crime gangs.
